messages:
mara: Heads-up — found base64-looking KMS ciphertext fragments in an old partner S3 bucket export. Looks like wrapped Vault values (transit). Not live creds but could be recovered if someone has the wrapping key.
eli: Can you paste a sanitized snippet?
mara: ```enc:b64:Gh3...==``` (sanitized) Found under s3://partner-archive/2024-10-*/logs/ingest.log.gz. Several entries over a 3h window.
anita: That path is from the partner ingest job that stopped rewrapping last fall during the vault transit key rotation. We may have missed rewrap on archived blobs.
josh: Ok so risk = ciphertext present + wrapping key still active somewhere. Action list: 1) confirm which wrapping key(s) could decrypt, 2) list services with access, 3) rotate/revoke keys and rewrap or destroy archived ciphertext.
mara: I ran `gs://s3` quick grep, matched ~42 files. They're gzipped; I can extract samples. Not doing wide download until we confirm keys.
eli: @rbac-bot can you dump the IAM roles that have decrypt on projects/kms/*/cryptoKeys/rewrap? We need the principal list.
rbac-bot: [automated] Querying KMS IAM for project-redwood-partner... returning 6 principals: serviceAcct:partner-ingest@, svc:legacy-worker@, group:platform-ops, user:anita@, user:josh@, group:external-integrations.
anita: That external-integrations group is what worries me — contains partner service accounts that shouldn't have rewrap rights. We changed RBAC after the incident but maybe older keys still accept decrypt.
josh: Compliance: we need an audit trail before any key rotation. @compliance what records do you need?
compliance: Audit log export of KMS decrypt/rewrap calls for the last 12 months + access list and ticket referencing the archival export. Also a statement of containment plan before rotation.
mara: Proposed immediate steps: (A) snapshot list of affected ciphertext files (I have hashes), (B) deny rewrap/decrypt to external-integrations group (temp deny binding), (C) rotate wrapping key with new key and set policy to refuse legacy rewrap, (D) rewrap archives server-side and rewrite S3 objects, (E) full audit export and ticket.
eli: I can implement (B) now with a conditional deny binding to the project's KMS. Will coordinate outage window if any service depends on that group.
anita: Before denies, we should map consumer dependencies. I'll run `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` on the keys and cross-ref with last 30d ops.
josh: If any production job breaks we need rollback. Plan to put canary deny for 15m then widen. Also create a feature-flagged fallback for partner ingest to use a different key if needed.
mara: I'm creating a tracker ticket: ENGSEC-9471. Adding MD notes + sample file list. Assigning owners: anita (key mapping), eli (RBAC deny), josh (rotation plan + fallback), mara (archive rewrap + artifacts), compliance (audit + sign-off).
compliance: We'll need a signed S3 object destruction log if you rewrite/remove ciphertexts. Keep all steps timestamped.
eli: Running deny now in staging project to validate no regressions. Will post results.
mara: Also note — Vault transit key rotation history shows a partial rewrap job failed at 2024-10-12 02:14 UTC with error `timeout`. Attaching log snippet in ticket.
josh: After we rotate, schedule a short all-hands with partner ops to confirm they rotate their local copies and purge archived exports.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: iam-policy-change v2 -> staging (by eli)
eli: Staging deny applied, no failures in the next 30m. Canary looks clean. Rolling to prod deny at 03:40 UTC after announcement.
anita: Mapped keys -> affected wrapping key is projects/project-redwood-partner/locations/global/keyRings/ring-Transit/cryptoKeys/wrap-v2. Service accounts that had access are being rotated in their own projects as well.
mara: Once deny is live, I'll coordinate a safe copy and then run server-side rewrap script to rewrite S3 objects to use new key. Script: ```python
# pseudocode
for obj in list_objects(bucket, prefix):
  data = download_and_decompress(obj)
  plaintext = transit_decrypt(old_key, data)
  new_ct = transit_encrypt(new_key, plaintext)
  upload_compressed(obj, new_ct)
```
eli: Reminder: ensure rewrap job runs from a locked, auditable runner and has no access to leave plaintext on disk. Use ephemeral GCE + encrypted scratch and wipe.
josh: Timeline: today - deny RBAC, generate audit export, tomorrow - rotate keys + rewrap archive, day-after - confirm partner purge. Notify infra and partners.
mara: I'll update the ticket with sample object list + hashes and post periodic status here. Please react with :thumbsup: when you accept assignments.
